Classify and record that scope explicitly; do not use this substitution for pilot blockers, authority/instruction text, storage/schema, host protocol/security/recovery behavior, or non-mechanical cross-cutting changes. Prepare clean current-master review freezes/manifests for candidates that need Claude at availability; reviewers need immutable exact inputs, not separate writable worktrees. The workspace tab-lookups extraction appears a possible simple candidate; assess/record it, while Node/Build/pilot work still waits for Claude."

This supersedes revision1's broad temporary-capacity substitution for future review/landing decisions. Record a concrete simple-isolated scope classification before using Kimi for Claude; actual capacity/refusal evidence and normal exact-input test/review/acceptance requirements remain. Complex/pilot/host-protocol/security/recovery and authority/storage/schema work requires Claude, with immutable current-input preparation while unavailable. Do not infer a pause of already authorized implementation from reviewer unavailability, nor waive review.

Historical revision1 retained Greg's earlier words via Advisor#42/message56c1154e-8cb3-4e85-9b19-58ef1ebe0163 at2026-10-06T19:46:42Z: “Kimi zastępuje Claude, aż będą tokeny”. Previous decisions and completed substitutions remain attributed to that then-current direction; do not rewrite them as Claude reviews.
